caption:
Truly grateful to the Government of Telangana @youngfilmmakerschallenge for inviting me to the Bathukamma Young Film Makers Challenge Awards 2026. ❤️🎬

It was an honour to be part of such a memorable event, meet inspiring personalities, interact with respected IAS officers, and learn valuable lessons from the Hon’ble Deputy Chief Minister of Telangana and Dil Raju garu.

An evening filled with inspiration, learning, meaningful conversations, and unforgettable memories. Experiences like these motivate me to dream bigger, keep learning, and work harder towards my goals.

Thank you for this wonderful opportunity. This is a memory I’ll always cherish! 🙏✨
